description: Main entry point for the Flutter newspaper/news reader application. It initializes dependencies such as environment variables, database, and application state management, then launches the root widget of the app.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Stateless widget that serves as the root of the Flutter app, embedding the NewsApp widget.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes Flutter bindings, loads environment variables, sets up database, and runs the Flutter app with providers.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the MyApp widget, returning the NewsApp widget.
